purpose: Improve six priority plus four secondary broad ideation families with concrete revised questions and real historical comparators; retain original wording in canonical Markdown.

protocol.presentation: Show comparator and revised question with counterbalanced order, and optionally show the unmodified original for wording critique; do not treat same-person differences as content uniqueness without asking why.
required_probes: 各問は何を尋ねたと感じたか
左右とも当てはまる・どちらも当てはまらないか
何が選択を左右したか（時間・金銭・技能・他者・疲労など）
既存問と同じ判断基準だと感じるか
この状況を想像できるか
protocol.B_axis: Use two independent 1–7 ratings, do not force a bipolar score.
protocol.scoring: No D197 material contributes to the current diagnostic score.
